Registry (0xcafea2c575550512582090AA06d0a069E7236b9e, ADVISORY_BOARD_SEATS() = 5) lists the Governor at contract index 2, is the proxyOwner() of all 10 module proxies resolved through NXMaster.getLatestAddress (GV, P1, MR, TC, CO, SP, RA, AS, CI, LO), and is itself an EIP-1967 proxy administered by the Governor; its verified upgradeContract is onlyGovernor. Pause: getPauseConfig() = 0; isEmergencyAdmin() is true for 6 EOAs (the 5 Advisory Board seat holders and 0x6fe2c2643cb5064951fb7dd87fbce4777fb146e3), and a pause needs one admin to propose and another to confirm. Context, not compared: the legacy NXMaster (0x01BFd82675DBCc7762C84019cA518e701C0cD07e) is owned by the legacy Governance proxy (0x4A5C681dDC32acC6ccA51ac17e9d461e6be87900) running TemporaryGovernance, whose advisoryBoardMultisig (0x51ad1265C8702c9e96Ea61Fe4088C2e22eD4418e, 3-of-5 Safe owned by the 5 seat holders) can execute any call through it without a timelock; the docs list NXMaster and Governance as legacy.

evidence.documented: docs.solv.finance/llms-full.txt: 'The admin privileges for upgrades are assigned to a Gnosis Safe multi-signature address ... The timelock mechanism will be added to further enhance security by introducing a delay between the upgrade proposal and execution.'
evidence.observed: SolvBTC is a beacon proxy: EIP-1967 beacon slot = UpgradeableBeacon 0xFc335FdA7E6a33329A83F4d5F578eC7d8A43DC4A (implementation() = 0xA4b6cf2BAaA235ab7Fe10EADB84b82460165B38F), whose owner() = SolvBTCFactory 0x443628281E4f3E5b5A5D029B9a0D13900ae41578 (getBeacon('Solv BTC') = that beacon). The factory's admin() = TimelockController 0xfd4B809AD88db6Ca9dbB295A4B9d23bB0093f497 (pendingAdmin() = 0) with getMinDelay() = 259200s (3d); governor() = the 3-of-5 Safe 0x0c2Bc4d2698820e12E6eBe863E7b9E2650CD5b7D (pendingGovernor() = 0), which holds the timelock's PROPOSER_ROLE, EXECUTOR_ROLE and CANCELLER_ROLE but not DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (held by the timelock itself; EXECUTOR_ROLE not open). Verified source pinned to runtime code: SolvBTCFactory is a Sourcify exact_match and every beacon-mutating path (setImplementation -> upgradeTo, transferBeaconOwnership, importBeacon) and transferAdmin is onlyAdmin, while onlyGovernor only deploys new beacon proxies; the timelock (SolvTimelock is OpenZeppelin v5.0.0 TimelockController, fully verified on Blockscout, not on Sourcify) reverts schedule when delay < getMinDelay() and only lets itself call updateDelay.
